description: Source code for a GUI button widget in the Wesnoth game project, including rendering, event handling, and state management.

classes.name: gui::button
classes.description: A GUI widget representing a button with various types (press, check, turbo), handling rendering, size calculation, and user interaction.

methods.name: calculate_size
methods.description: Calculates and sets the size of the button based on its label and type.

methods.name: set_check
methods.description: Sets the checked state for check-type buttons.

methods.name: checked
methods.description: Returns whether the button is in a checked state.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Returns whether the button is enabled.

methods.name: draw_contents
methods.description: Renders the button's visual appearance based on its current state.

methods.name: hit
methods.description: Checks if a point (x, y) is within the button's area.

methods.name: set_label
methods.description: Sets the button's label text and recalculates size.

methods.name: mouse_motion
methods.description: Handles mouse movement events for hover state management.

methods.name: mouse_up
methods.description: Handles mouse button up events, updating button state accordingly.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Processes SDL events related to mouse interaction.

methods.name: pressed
methods.description: Returns whether the button was pressed since last checked.
